name: 2VD0102 · G1/4
description: Source-identified one-way flow control; illustrative geometry with unresolved dimensions and contradictory supplier fields.

catalog.sourceName: AMRtechnologi / Prom.ua selected listing and product photo

geometryEvidence.summary: Illustrative photo-based reference; no dimensioned product geometry or installed occurrence is available.
geometryEvidence.limitations: The selected AMRtechnologi listing identifies 2VD0102, seller code 0891000003, as a screwdriver-adjusted one-way flow control for a G1/4 banjo interface. Its structured fields conflict with its description: 1/8 versus 1/4 thread, aluminium versus brass, incompatible temperature ranges and 239 MPa versus 10 bar pressure. Manufacturer AZ is seller-listed but no primary AZ order-code cross-reference to 2VD0102 was established. No dimensioned drawing or original CAD was found. Geometry is an illustrative photo-based reference only: assumed Ø12 waist, 18 mm hex width across flats, 30 mm overall length, radial openings and a slotted adjuster; photo-visible O-rings are omitted. None of those dimensions, O-ring sections, seating depths or port geometry is verified. The nominal lower cylinder does not certify male/internal thread type or mating fit. No pressure, flow, material or temperature rating is published as a numeric library characteristic. The existing band-saw BOM references two units, but it contains no placed flow-control geometry; registration does not invent installed occurrences. Obtain an exact execution drawing and verify the metering direction before design or procurement release.
